=== Tiered Bonus ===
Similar to the {{AN|Efficient Miner}} perk in the [[Heart of the Mountain]] that grants {{Stat|Mining Spread}}, {{Item|Mineral Armor}} grants extra {{Stat|Mining Spread}} on '''Ores''' and '''Blocks'''.

== Skins ==
{{Item Skins|Mineral Helmet}}

== Trivia== 
*It was once possible to obtain a [[Armor|Dungeon Armor]] version of this set by turning the base [[Hardened Diamond Armor]] into a dungeon item via Essence Crafting.
*This set was best used for leveling up {{Skl|Mining}} by mining [[End Stone|End Stone]] in the [[End Island|End]]. When using this method, it was best to use a [[Stonk]] so that [[Endermite]]s didn't spawn. This method could result in up to {{Skill XP|600000 Mining}} per hour. However, since the introduction of the {{Zone|Dwarven Mines}} and {{Zone|Crystal Hollows}}, mining [[Mithril]] or completing [[commissions]] is much more efficient.
*Although it isn't stated in the armor itself, the Mineral Armor special effect does not work on private islands.
*Mineral armor was added before Mining Spread was a stat.
